lines.en: I find myself heading over to the maid cafe because Ami is cute.
lines.zh: 因为 Ami 可爱，我发现自己正往女仆咖啡厅走去。

lines.en: I spend the next hour thinking about how cute Ami is.
lines.zh: 接下来的一个小时，我都在想 Ami 有多可爱。

lines.en: When she brings me her famous omurice, the first thing I think is “Wow, she is so cute.”
lines.zh: 她端来她那招牌蛋包饭时，我第一个念头是「哇，她好可爱」。

lines.en: After that, she sits down at the table with me and is cute again.
lines.zh: 之后她在我桌边坐下，又可爱了一遍。

lines.en: Sometimes I think I'm going insane. But then I realize I'm not insane at all. It's just that Ami is so cute and my brain can not comprehend it.
lines.zh: 有时候我觉得自己要疯了。但随后我意识到我根本没疯。只是 Ami 太可爱，我的大脑处理不了。

lines.en: When I am looking at Ami, I feel safe and happy because of how cute she is.
lines.zh: 看着 Ami 的时候，我因为她太可爱而感到安心又幸福。

lines.en: Ami is the only girl I will ever need.
lines.zh: Ami 是我唯一需要的女孩。

lines.en: Ami is the cutest girl in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: Ami 是全世界最可爱的女孩。
